resources.string: Another device signed in to your account saved its settings %1$s: add-ons, debrid services, Usenet providers and indexers, and preferences. Load them on this device? The app restarts to use them.
This device also has changes that weren\'t backed up. Loading replaces them; keeping this device\'s settings replaces the other device\'s in your account.
